title: Macluumaadka su'aasha
description: Soo saar macluumaad macne guud oo ku saabsan su'aalaha hagaha doorashada, oo ay ku jiraan qeexidda erayada iyo qaybaha macluumaadka, si ay codbixiyayaashu si wanaagsan u fahmaan su'aalaha.

sectionTopics.label: Mawduucyada qaybaha (ikhtiyaari)
sectionTopics.help: Liis ay hakadku kala qaybiso oo ah mawduucyo loogu talagalay qaybaha macluumaadka. Bannaan uga tag si loo isticmaalo kuwa caadiga ah.
sectionTopics.placeholder: Asalka, Xaaladda hadda, Daneeyayaasha muhiimka ah

customInstructions.label: Tilmaamo gaar ah (ikhtiyaari)
customInstructions.help: Hagitaan dheeraad ah oo LLM-ka lagu siinayo sida loo soo saaro nuxurka.
customInstructions.placeholder: Diirradda saar maamulka maxalliga ah iyo dhinacyada siyaasadda degmooyinka

questionContext.label: Macnaha guud ee su'aasha (ikhtiyaari)
questionContext.help: Macne guud oo ku saabsan doorashada ama mawduuca, si LLM-ka looga caawiyo inuu soo saaro nuxur ku habboon.

validation.noQuestions: Fadlan dooro ugu yaraan hal su'aal
validation.noOperations: Fadlan dooro ugu yaraan hal xulasho oo soo saaris ah
